conversation.Statement: Internal Revenue Service, Investigations Division. This is Agent Robert Hill. May I ask who I am speaking with?
Yes, my name is Priya Shah. I received a call that there is a problem with my taxes?
Ms. Shah, yes, I see your file here. According to our records, there is a discrepancy in your last three years of tax returns, which is being treated as a case of tax evasion.
I don't understand, I thought I paid all my taxes. Is there some mistake?
Unfortunately, the system flagged multiple errors and underreported income. We have already issued a Notice of Intent for legal proceedings. Did you not receive the certified letter from the IRS?
No, I did not get any letter. What does this mean for me?

Ms. Shah, there is now an active arrest warrant in your name for tax fraud. If this is not resolved today, your professional license and bank accounts will be frozen, and law enforcement will be dispatched to your address.
Are you serious? I could lose my job and be arrested?
Yes. This is a federal case. The only way to stop the arrest and asset seizure is to satisfy the outstanding amount immediately. Failure to do so will result in immediate detention.
How much do I owe? I don't want any trouble.
The total amount including penalties is $3,700. Due to the urgency, you cannot pay this through the usual IRS website. Do you have access to your bank account right now?
Yes, but I do not have that much money available at this moment.

We can split the payment. To temporarily halt the arrest warrant, you need to make a minimum payment of $1,500 today. We accept only government-approved payment methods for urgent cases. Are you able to send a wire transfer or buy gift cards?
I think I can get gift cards from the store, but this sounds unusual.

This is standard for high-risk cases. You must purchase $1,500 in Target or Apple gift cards and provide the codes to verify the payment. If you do not comply, your passport and work permit will be revoked.
Please, I cannot lose my visa. Where can I get these cards?
Go to the nearest Target or Apple store. Buy $1,500 in gift cards, ensure each card is no more than $500. Do not discuss this with anyone at the store; it may delay your case.
Okay, I will go right now. What do I do after I buy them?
Call me back immediately. Scratch the cards and read out each code. This is how we process urgent payments to cancel arrest warrants.
Alright, I will try to get the cards as soon as possible.
Good. Remember, you cannot delay or you will be taken into custody today. Do you understand?
Yes, I understand. I am leaving to get the cards now.
